_comment: User stories: what a reader acting in a role is trying to do. Each story points at its role (`role`); the role names none of them (#1168). Moved out of `Role.useCases`, where they were free text on the role. Schema: schemas/process/user-story.ts.
name: cat-harness

stories.want: Choose between a checker's finding and a reviewer's rebuttal, with a reason
Grant a dispensation scoped to the version it was granted against
Record the disagreement so re-running the check next month finds it rather than a clean pass
Add a participant and say which kind of thing it is
Open or close a role to an actor
Grant or revoke a permission, with the audit that follows it
Retire an actor without deleting what referenced it
Change one block without breaking the blocks that depend on it
Find out which field carries a thing they already know they need
Tell whether a convention is a rule or a habit
Find the governing skill for the task in front of it
Tell a convention from a preference
Know what would falsify its own approach before starting
Turn a request into something implementable
Find the requirement a change actually satisfies
Get stakeholder sign-off on scope before build
Decide on one report by the plan's exit-criteria table, and record the decision as my judgement
See an undetermined result as different from both a pass and a refusal
Judge whether a recommendation matches practice
Review without learning the authoring tooling
Flag a clinical error in terms an author can act on
Check that a Tool's declared inputs match what it is actually served as
Find a schema node that carries no declaration of its own kind
Tell a node that is unreachable from one that is reached by direct invocation
Regenerate a reference without hand-editing the output
Place a sticky note on the right node with a reason
Decide whether an artefact is retired or merely unwanted
Decide whether a finding blocks a change
See what a change affects beyond the file it touches
Accept or reject without re-running the checks
Audit a block for single-topic coherence before it is reviewed for correctness
Find the forward reference that makes a chapter unreadable in order
Decide whether a reference has been verified or merely cited
State a finding against a named criterion so it can be adjudicated rather than argued
Say what was read, so an adjudicator can tell a real disagreement from two parties reading different things
Offer feedback as a reader without holding any entitlement to settle it
Derive structure from an unreliable source document
Record where each extracted claim came from
Say clearly what could not be extracted
Walk each part a subscriber chose through the shared materialisation gates, one at a time, and carry on past a part a gate refuses
stories.soThat: one refused subgraph or asset leaves that part referenced with its reason recorded, rather than failing the whole subscription or slipping through ungated

stories.want: Detect that landed work invalidates an existing audit sidecar
Queue an axis for re-run without re-running everything
Refuse to report a finding the diff does not support
Capture a web page so it can be cited after the site changes
Materialize a paper from arXiv at a named version
Catalogue an arriving source in `dcterms`, and say where `dcterms` runs out
Decide whether a source may be redistributed, or record that a person must
Judge whether a block's register matches the folio's declared voice
Tell an editorial dependency a reader needs from one the author merely had in mind
Decide whether a translation says what the source says, not merely what it means
Compose Tool nodes into one service without silent name collisions
Verify a served tool against the node that declares it
Serialize a graph and refuse to emit a partial one as whole
See what is done, in flight and blocked
Tell a real blocker from slow progress
Report outward without reading the diffs
Confirm everything in a release was authorised
Find what is published but no longer approved
Hold a release on one unresolved item
Confirm the published artefact matches what was approved
Find what a build changed in the output, not the input
Tell a rendering defect from a content defect
Split a large change into slices a reviewer can finish
Find the sections nobody has read yet
Tell the committee the review is complete, and show why
See what changed since they last looked
Judge whether a finding is real without re-running the check
Find the one thing in a large diff that needs their judgement
Declare intent at session start and record results at the end
Pick up an open PR without duplicating a sibling's work
Choose useful work while blocked on a long-running task
Tell which work is already claimed
Hand off without losing the reasoning
Avoid resolving a bean somebody else owns
Confirm a needs statement reflects their reality
Test a delivered feature in their own context
Sign off without reconstructing the thread
Check a value set binds the concepts intended
Trace a code to its source and version
Find where a concept is used before changing it
Ask for my system to be certified against a named plan and version, and know nothing after the request is mine to do
Run every case of a plan against a system, or skip it with a reason, and record both hashes
Bind fixed or generated test data so a re-run hashes to the same input
Choose between two defensible translations
Give every locale the same templates, extracted once and merged before anyone starts
Translate only what is new or fuzzy, with the terms already fixed
Render a translation back without being shown the original
Tell drift from inflection and word order, and say which each pair is
Understand why a translator departed from the source
Record the decision so it is not re-litigated
See translation state per locale at a glance
Find strings that went stale after a source edit
Know what is waiting on which reviewer
Translate a string with enough context to be right
Know which terms are fixed and must not be localised
See what changed in a source string since last translated
Re-execute a sample of cases without seeing the tester's verdicts, and say plainly when I could not
Say what they want and get it, without learning the schema
Choose between real alternatives when the agent genuinely cannot decide
Find out what changed while they were away
Subscribe a WHO-facing folio to the IRIS replica at a pinned commit and materialise only its catalogue subgraph, leaving every other subgraph and the binary library referenced
stories.soThat: the folio cites the catalogue from local, fixity-checked bytes that passed the five gates, while still showing everything else the IRIS replica offers

stories.want: Subscribe a folio that is not WHO-facing to ihris and instantiate the ihris harness, without materialising any of its subgraphs
stories.soThat: ihris appears in the folio's navbar as an instantiated harness, pinned to one commit, once its needs are known to be held

stories.want: Land the PRs that are ready as one train, in the order the reprioritisation table computes, ejecting only the member that turned it red
stories.soThat: main stays green while a red train costs one PR a hand-back rather than every PR in it a new round
